spec.scope: Counts landed NORMAL-attack rounds only (MG hitsPerShot=1, so 60 bullets); skill/burst/rider hits must not advance the counter.
spec.durationSemantics: Trigger is a cumulative hit counter (repeats every 60); attached debuff below is 3 wall-clock seconds.
spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount count:60 (counts ROUNDS). NOT interval, NOT lastBullet. At MG sustained ~60 rounds/s this fires roughly once per second of fire — cadence is fire-rate-coupled.
spec.nearestWrongModel: interval sec:~1 (or shotFired everyN) — decouples proc cadence from actual rounds landed, so wind-up/reload downtime no longer suppresses procs.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Count her skill1 rider damage events (mult≈158.43): count === floor(totalRoundsFired/60) and drops when reload downtime grows (e.g. patch out her burst reloadSpeedPct → proc count falls). An interval model keeps count fixed at ~fightSec/CD regardless of rounds fired.
spec.inertness: Zero procs before the first 60 rounds land (none in the opening ~1s+wind-up); teammates' shots never advance her counter.

spec.scope: Boss DEBUFF — benefits ALL five units' damage, not just hers.
spec.durationSemantics: 3 wall-clock sec, refreshed every 60-round proc → near-continuous uptime while she sustains fire (~1s proc cadence at MG rate), but gaps during her reloads (201 frames > 3s window can lapse).
spec.triggerIdentity: Same hitCount:60 block as the rider.
spec.targetSet: enemy — engine emits boss-held debuff buffApply with casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null; filter by stat+value.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Encoded as a SELF buff (damageTakenPct or attackDamagePct on herself) — under-credits the four teammates entirely; secondary misread: durationSec:60 or permanent (ignoring lapse during her reload).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply {stat:'damageTakenPct', value:12.56, casterIdx:null, targetIdx:null} appears repeatedly with expiresFrame−applyFrame===180; AND totals(res) for a TEAMMATE (e.g. helm) drop when ludmilla-winter-owner's override is patched to remove this effect. Red if the buffApply carries her own targetIdx or teammate totals don't move.
spec.inertness: Must lapse during her ~3.35s reload (201f) unless the instant +20-round refill keeps her firing — assert at least that uptime < 100% of fight when reloads occur.

spec.scope: flatDamage rider, % of HER final ATK; crits at caster rate, NO core, engine forces no-range on riders; takes +50% FB by landing timing (default noFb OFF).
spec.nearestWrongModel: core:true (it lands on the boss she's core-shooting, tempting) or noFb:true without measurement — either shifts the rider's bucket math.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Her rider damage events have core rate 0 (no core bucket contribution), fbMajorApplied true when landing inside FB, rangeApplied false, mult≈158.43. Red under core:true (core bucket >0 on rider events).
spec.inertness: Rider damage must not scale with coreDamagePct buffs.

spec.scope: Weapon-state effect — this IS damage (taxonomy #6): +20/300 per 60 fired makes net magazine drain 40 per 60, stretching the 300-round belt to ~450 shots between reloads, cutting 201-frame reload downtime ~33%.
spec.triggerIdentity: Second ■ block, same hitCount:60, Affects self → instantReload fraction 20/300≈0.0667 (NOT full refill, NOT maxAmmoFlat).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Skipped as 'defensive/no damage', OR encoded as maxAmmoFlat:20 (one-time capacity bump instead of a repeating refill), OR instantReload with default fraction 1 (never reloads all fight — wildly over-credits uptime).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Reload-event count over 180s ≈ shots/450 not shots/300 (fewer reloads than the naive belt), and total shots fired STRICTLY increase vs a patched override dropping the effect; but reload events remain >0 (red under fraction:1, which would produce zero reloads while firing).
spec.inertness: Must not change max ammo capacity (no maxAmmoFlat buffApply).

spec.scope: Counts CORE hits only — cadence scales with her core-hit rate, not raw rounds.
spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount count:60 + requiresCore:true on the block. THE key trap of this kit.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Plain hitCount:60 WITHOUT the core gate — over-fires by 1/coreRate (if her core rate is e.g. 0.5, doubles the 109.64% rider count). This is the highest-expected shared-prior misread.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Rider(≈109.64) proc count === floor(coreHits/60), strictly < floor(totalHits/60); AND with core exposure forced to zero (or a no-core configuration) the proc count is exactly 0 while the skill1 rider (plain 60-hit) still fires. Red under the ungated model (both riders proc at identical cadence).
spec.inertness: Zero procs when the fight has no core exposure.

spec.scope: flatDamage rider % of her final ATK; same rider defaults as skill1's (crit at caster rate, no core, no range, FB by timing).
spec.nearestWrongModel: core:true ('it triggered off core hits, so it must core-hit') — the text says additional damage, not core strike damage.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: These rider damage events carry no core-bucket scaling (core rate 0) and mult≈109.64. Red if core:true.

spec.kitLine: beginning of Full Burst… Crit Rate ▲14.6%
spec.scope: GENERIC critRatePct (prose is unscoped 'Critical Rate', not 'of normal attacks') — applies to normals AND her crit-eligible riders.
spec.triggerIdentity: fullBurstEnter — 'at the beginning of Full Burst' = ANY team FB, including rotations where a co-B3 (helm in controlComp) casts instead of her.
spec.nearestWrongModel: burstCast — fires only on HER burst rotations; in the control comp with helm sharing B3, this under-credits every helm-led FB. (Inverse of the usual over-credit trap — direction flips because the prose here genuinely says FB-enter.)
spec.distinguishingAssertion: A buffApply {stat:'critRatePct', value:14.6, target self} occurs at EVERY fullBurstStart event, including FBs not preceded by her own burstCast event. Red under burstCast keying (missing on helm-led FBs).
spec.inertness: No application outside FB entries; expires ~600 frames later (expiresFrame check).

spec.scope: atkPct on self (scales her own ATK; NOT casterAtkPct flat-add, NOT allies).
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast — her own burst block with no activation clause; fires ONLY on rotations she casts B3, not on helm-led FBs.
spec.nearestWrongModel: fullBurstEnter — over-credits by applying the 62.54% on every FB even when the co-B3 bursts (taxonomy #3, the classic over-credit direction in a 2×B3 comp).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply {stat:'atkPct', value:62.54, casterIdx===targetIdx===her index} count === her burstCast event count, and NO application at fullBurstStart events lacking her preceding burstCast. Red under fullBurstEnter (count === total FB count).
spec.inertness: Never applied to allies; absent on helm-led rotations.

spec.scope: Weapon-state modifier — IS damage (shrinks the 201-frame reload, raising shots fired); reloadSpeedPct, self.
spec.durationSemantics: 20 sec — DOUBLE the ATK line's window; outlasts the 10s FB. The two effects on one cast must carry DIFFERENT durations.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Skipped as 'utility/no damage', or duration collapsed to 10s alongside the ATK buff (copy-the-sibling-duration error).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply {stat:'reloadSpeedPct', value:67.2} at her burstCast with expiresFrame−applyFrame===1200 while the sibling atkPct apply shows 600; and a reload event landing in t∈(cast+10s, cast+20s) is shortened vs baseline. Red under a 10s or missing encoding.
spec.inertness: No effect on allies' reloads; expired by cast+20s.

notes: Every line maps to an existing primitive — nothing should land in `unmodeled`. Expected shared-prior misreads to check hardest: (1) skill2's counter counting ALL hits instead of CORE hits (hitCount:60 without requiresCore over-fires by 1/coreRate — the single biggest damage swing in this kit); (2) the +20-round refill dropped as 'non-damage' or mis-encoded as maxAmmoFlat/full instantReload — its faithful effect is stretching the 300-belt to ~450 shots between reloads; (3) Damage Taken ▲ mis-scoped to self instead of a boss-held debuff (it's the kit's team-support payload — verify a TEAMMATE's total moves when it's patched out); (4) trigger-identity split across the kit: skill2's crit buff is fullBurstEnter (fires on helm-led FBs too) while BOTH burst buffs are burstCast (fire only on her rotations) — a single shared keying either over- or under-credits in the 2×B3 control comp; (5) the two burst buffs carry different durations (10s vs 20s) — assert both expiresFrames, not just presence. Whole-picture cadence sanity: at MG ~60 rounds/s the skill1 pair procs ~1/s of sustained fire, so Damage-Taken uptime is high but must lapse across her (now rarer) reloads. All magnitudes are kit-literal (DATAMINED); the only ⚑-class inputs are her MG cadence/wind-up (engine-owned, not this override's concern) and her core-hit rate feeding skill2 cadence (engine band table — tests should assert proportionality to core hits, not a hardcoded proc count).
